TCS TwinX 3.0 UI

Component catalog

Every component in the library, live. Pick a theme to check it in all five CXO palettes, then copy the markup into your page. Pages link ui/twinx/twinx.css and load ui/twinx/js/twinx.js.

Button button

The one button for every action. Primary for the main action of a view, secondary for everything else, ghost for low-emphasis actions in toolbars, danger for destructive actions.

Stable
When to use
Any clickable action. Use one primary button per view or dialog. Use an <a class="tx-btn"> only when it navigates.
Accessibility
Use <button type="button"> (or type="submit" in forms). Icon-only buttons need aria-label. Disabled state uses the disabled attribute, not a class.
Replaces
.btn-primary .btn-validate .btn-next .btn-create .btn-outline .btn-outline-icon .btn-square .icon-btn .ad-btn .pd-btn .pp-btn .rp-btn .ub
Files
ui/twinx/components/button/ · owner Muthu · since 1.0.0
Class or attributeUse it for
tx-btn--primaryMain action. Brand fill, lifts to the menu-bar colour on hover.
tx-btn--secondaryDefault action. Card surface, line border, gold on hover.
tx-btn--ghostLow emphasis, no border until hover.
tx-btn--dangerDestructive action (delete, reject).
tx-btn--iconSquare icon-only button. Needs aria-label.
tx-btn--sm28px high, for tables and dense toolbars.
tx-btn--blockFull width, for narrow forms and mobile.

Context bar context-bar

One dark band of key facts about the record being viewed (promotion, market, period, owner), in the menu bar colours, with an optional gold action chip.

Stable
When to use
Top of detail pages (result, workflow, logistics) to keep the record in view. One per page, under the page header.
Accessibility
Facts are a <dl>: each fact is a <div> with <dt> label and <dd> value.
Replaces
.res-summary .wf-summary .vs-summary .res-fact .res-chip

Class or attributeUse it for

Data table data-table

Sticky uppercase header, hairline rows, gold row hover, numeric columns right-aligned. The wrapper scrolls sideways with a visible scrollbar on wide tables.

Stable
When to use
Any tabular data. Put it in a card with tx-card__body--flush, add tx-pagination in the card footer. Use tx-table--dense for long lists and tx-table--lines for column lines.
Accessibility
Use <th scope="col">. Give the table a <caption> (it can be visually hidden with tx-sr-only). Sortable headers use a button inside the th and aria-sort on the th.
Replaces
.table-wrap .ad-table-wrap .rp-table-wrap .vs-table-wrap .wf-table-wrap .cmp-metrics
Files
ui/twinx/components/data-table/ · owner Muthu · since 1.0.0
Class or attributeUse it for
tx-table-wrapScrolling frame. Set --tx-table-h to fix the height (sticky header scrolls inside).
tx-table--denseShorter rows (32px).
tx-table--linesColumn lines; headers are centred.
tx-table--zebraAlternate row tint.
is-numCell class: right-aligned tabular figures (header follows).
is-centerCell class: centred.
is-selectedRow class: selected row.

KPI tile kpi-tile

A single figure with a micro label and an optional change indicator. Tiles sit in a row inside a summary card.

Stable
When to use
Headline numbers (volume, uplift, budget). Put several in a tx-kpi-row. Tiles inside a summary card are the one allowed exception to 'no box in a box'.
Accessibility
Say the direction in words too (for example '+4.2% vs last year'), not only with colour or an arrow.
Replaces
.rp-tile .an-tile .trend-tile .rm-count

tx-kpi__delta--upPositive change (green).
tx-kpi__delta--downNegative change (red).
tx-kpi--accentGold top edge, for the one figure that matters most.

Toast toast

A short message that slides in at the bottom right and fades after a few seconds. Also an inline alert for messages that stay on the page.

Stable
When to use
Toast: confirm an action that happened ('Saved', 'Submitted for approval'). Alert: a message that must stay visible (validation summary, warning about data).
Accessibility
The toast region is aria-live="polite". Alerts that need immediate attention use role="alert".
Files
ui/twinx/components/toast/ · owner Muthu · since 1.0.0
Class or attributeUse it for
TwinX.toast(message, {tone})JavaScript call; tone is success, danger, info or warning.
tx-alertInline message block.
tx-alert--success / --warning / --danger / --infoTone of the alert.

Checkbox, radio and switch checkbox

Themed checkbox, radio and on/off switch, each with its label in one clickable row.

Stable
When to use
Checkbox for independent options and table row selection; radio for one choice out of a few; switch for a setting that applies at once.
Accessibility
Use native inputs inside a <label>. Group radios in a <fieldset> with a <legend>. A switch is <input type="checkbox" role="switch">.

.checkbox .fam-check .msrp-check .pp-toggle

Field field

Label, control and help or error text for text inputs, selects, textareas and search boxes. 36px controls with a gold focus ring.

Stable
When to use
Every form control. Wrap the control in tx-field so label, help and error stay consistent. Use tx-field--inline for a label beside the control.
Accessibility
Every control has a <label for>. Help and error text are linked with aria-describedby. Required fields use the required attribute and show '*' in the label.

.field .field__control .ue-field .pp-field .uf__box .cfg-input .cfg-select .text-input .sa-input .vol-input .vs-input

App shell and menu bar app-shell

The page frame: a dark menu bar on the left (collapsed to 72px, opens in place on hover and pushes the content over, pin button keeps it open), a scrolling main column with tight padding, and a drawer below 900px. The theme picker lives in the menu bar footer.

Stable
When to use
Every app page. Start from ui/patterns/page-template.html rather than writing the shell by hand. Change the brand badge, title and nav items only.
Accessibility
The menu bar is an <aside aria-label="Main menu"> with a <nav>. Collapsed items keep their label for screen readers (title + hidden text). Keyboard focus inside the collapsed menu opens it. The drawer closes on Escape.
Replaces
.page .main .sidebar .nav-item .sidebar__brand .sidebar__footer .profile .lang .mobile-bar .theme-menu
Files
ui/twinx/components/app-shell/ · owner Muthu · since 1.0.0

tx-sidebar__sectionGroup label in the menu.

html.is-nav-collapsedCollapsed state, set before first paint by the head script.

Card card

The one container for a block of content: a titled section with an optional toolbar, a body and a footer.

Stable
When to use
Every block on a page. One container per block: never put a framed card inside another card. Tables, filter bars and forms inside a card sit flush (their frame is removed automatically).
Accessibility
Give the card's title an id and set aria-labelledby on the <section>.
Replaces
.card .ad-card .es-card .res-card .pd-card .rp-card .vs-card .projects-card

tx-card__footFooter row (pagination, summary, actions).
tx-card--elevatedSlight gradient and deeper shadow, for hero blocks.

Layout helpers and icons layout

Stack, row and grid helpers that space components with the spacing tokens, the stroke icon class, and small utilities (screen-reader-only text, muted text, numbers).

Stable
When to use
Spacing between components inside a card or page body. Use these before writing page CSS. Grids collapse to one column below 900px.
Accessibility
Icons inside buttons are aria-hidden; the button carries the label.
Files
ui/twinx/components/layout/ · owner Muthu · since 1.0.0
Class or attributeUse it for

tx-rowHorizontal wrap row, 8px gap (--between, --end).
tx-gridAuto-fit grid, min column --tx-grid-min (220px); --2 and --3 fixed columns.
tx-iconStroke icon (Lucide style svg, viewBox 0 0 24 24); --sm 14px, --lg 20px.

Page header page-header

Breadcrumb, serif page title, a one-line lead and actions on the right. Every page starts with one.

Stable
When to use
Top of every page, first child of tx-main. Put the page's main actions (or a stepper) in tx-page-header__actions. Use tx-kicker for a small gold label above a title.
Accessibility
One <h1> per page, here. The breadcrumb is a <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with aria-current="page" on the last item.

Stepper stepper

Compact step indicator for multi-step flows: done steps show a green check, the current step is a raised pill, upcoming steps are muted.

Stable
When to use
Wizards such as create promotion → configure → simulate → submit. Put it in the page header actions or above the form.
Accessibility
Use an <ol>. Mark the current step with aria-current="step". Done steps can be links back.
Replaces
.stepper .stepper__step .stepper__item

Tabs and segmented control tabs

A tinted track with the active tab raised on the card surface. The same look serves page tabs (switch panels) and segmented controls (switch a view or a filter).

Stable
When to use
Tabs switch between panels of one page. A segmented control switches a view of the same data (Monthly / Quarterly). Up to about 6 options; the track scrolls sideways if it runs out of room.
Accessibility
role="tablist" / "tab" / "tabpanel" with aria-selected and aria-controls. twinx.js adds arrow-key navigation. A segmented control uses aria-pressed on its buttons.
Replaces
.tabs .tabs__list .tab .tab--active .segments .segment .rp-tabs .pd-tabs .res-tabs .art-tabs .rf-tabs .es-status

Modal dialog modal

Centred card on a dimmed, blurred backdrop with a gold top edge. Built on the native <dialog> element.

Stable
When to use
Confirmations, short forms and details that need focus. Not for long flows (use a page). One primary button in the footer, on the right.
Accessibility
Native <dialog> with showModal() traps focus and closes on Escape. Give it aria-labelledby pointing at the title.

Badge badge

A small tinted pill with a dot that shows a status: approved, pending, in progress, rejected, draft.

Stable
When to use
Statuses in tables, cards and headers. Not for actions (use a button) and not for counts on icons (use tx-count).
Accessibility
The status must be in the text, never only in the colour.
Replaces
